descriptionMarkdown:
When an injury destroys or permanently impairs a body 
part, an appropriate augmetic can remove the injury 
penalty once installed and recovered from. Standard 
replacements restore 
normal function. Advanced replacements may also 
grant an Augmetic Upgrade from Chapter 13, subject 
to Availability, facilities and GM approval.
An augmetic obtained as treatment does not 
automatically consume a Talent choice. If it grants a 
significant mechanical upgrade beyond restored 
function, use the normal Augmetic Upgrade rules or 
treat the extra capability as a campaign reward.
